instruction:
Enable the On-Screen Keyboard. Using the On-Screen Keyboard, open Text Editor and create a note with the following content:

Shopping List
- Milk
- Bread
- Eggs

Save the note as shopping.txt on the Desktop.
gt_steps: Using the On-Screen Keyboard, type 'Shopping List'.
Save the file as shopping.txt on the Desktop.

parameters.command: cmd /c if exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\shopping.txt del C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\shopping.txt

result.command: cmd /c if exist C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\shopping.txt type C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\shopping.txt
